{"kind":"arsenal-item","definition":{"id":"trinket.whetstone","kind":"pocket-item","name":"随身砺锋石","glyph":"砺","summary":"放在战斗行囊时提高主人物理威力，只增强使用这项威力的物理攻击。","drawWeight":1.15,"rarityBand":[1,5],"inventorySize":{"width":1,"height":1},"effectRefs":[{"effectId":"effect.trinket.whetstone.physical-power","assetGuid":"3bf8a97a-1ed4-578b-a51d-4e7511763fc1","programFingerprint":"effect-program/1:6895:4868736d252e7019"}],"affixPool":{"sourceEffectId":"effect.trinket.whetstone.physical-power","version":3,"excludedReason":"砺石只允许已逐项审定的磨锋或主人防护刻纹，其他效果不能因运或关联获得准入。","acquisition":{"requiresReceiver":"owner-physical-power-attack","excludedReason":"本次出征没有可获得且使用主人物理威力的攻击，砺锋石不进入新掉落或新发售；原物品与报价保留。"},"rules":[{"effectId":"effect.affix.xuantie-hardening","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"坚铸是玄铁护心镜的专属锻甲工艺，砺石不能获得这项资格。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.owner-qi-capacity","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有纳气储仓，放在行囊里不等于拥有扩充主人灵池的结构。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.xuantie-heart-lining","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有护具内衬，不因衬心移入共享目录而获得固定气血词。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.qingxin-clear-radiance-radius","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"展照只调节同件清心额带的清辉，砺石没有这项来源。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.minglv-counter-resonance","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"逆律依赖鸣律击伤并耗去雷痕，砺石没有攻击或耗印工序。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.contact-weakness","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"灼弱需要本剑实际击伤，砺石不能用佩戴代替接触。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.quick-withdrawal","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"石芯没有翻滚回弹或复位工艺，不用轻撤补足砺石词数。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"磨粒含金属不等于刻有抗金结界，砺石不随机金御。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.earth-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"石芯抗土刻纹尚未审定，也没有本件防护接线，首轮不开放土御。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"磨石用水不代表主人获得水行抗性。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fire-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"经火锻制不等于仍有隔热保护，砺石没有护火工艺。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-ward","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有木纤维护体或抗木结构，不用五行防御词填池。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.impact-guard","allowed":true,"weight":0.8,"reason":"石芯可刻镇定重心的纹路，减少主人受击后的击退距离；不减伤、不防打断。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.qi-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"节灵只减少本剑器气开支，砺石没有剑体账本，不能替全体飞剑节灵。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.turning-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石不飞行，也不控制飞剑转弯，转锋没有本地受体。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.owner-qi-recovery","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石不生产主人灵力，磨锋不等于聚灵回气。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-mending","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有药性或养脉工艺，磨刃用水不能用来证明主人回血。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.blade-integrity","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"固刃增加剑体器命，砺石既不是剑体也不把它转换为主人气血。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fuel-efficiency","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石不以外飞燃命工作，没有惜薪可降低的器命费用。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.repair-reception","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"伙伴修剑入口不接收行囊石头，受援不能变成主人回血。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.blade-concord","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本件没有行囊光环消费者，不借防具作用域让砺石生成锋和。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.canopy","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"本案没有给行囊物新增防护光环来源，砺石不随机青荫。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.tide-return","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有补剑光环消费者，回潮不能在行囊中自动成为全场补灵。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.critical-force","allowed":true,"weight":0.65,"reason":"细磨刃口支持稳定爆发，增加主人的暴击倍率；必须有实际可暴击攻击。","requiresReceiver":"critical-equipment"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.cast-mobility","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有施法稳息工艺，也没有行囊施法光环消费者。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.tempered","allowed":true,"weight":1.6,"reason":"反复整平磨面提高主人物理威力比例；与砺石固有比例相加，必须有可获得的物理正系数攻击。","requiresReceiver":"owner-physical-power-attack"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.keen","allowed":true,"weight":1.2,"reason":"精细刃痕帮助主人抓住会心机会，增加暴击概率百分点；必须有可暴击攻击。","requiresReceiver":"critical-equipment"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.swift","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"流光当前新词只强化对应飞剑补灵，旧行囊字段不能代替本件新准入。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.windborne","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"御风已退出新随机池，本件不借旧兼容字段恢复生成。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.far-seeking","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"寻远已退池，磨石也不提供远距离引导。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.mountain","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"镇岳已退出新池，砺石的冲击工艺和共享接线未审定，首轮不计。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.guardian","allowed":true,"weight":0.5,"reason":"坚硬石芯可刻护体纹，给主人增加护甲点数，抵御物理来伤；不增加剑体生命。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.vital","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有气血容器或养身工艺，不因是随身物就默认增加生命上限。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spirit-ward","allowed":true,"weight":0.4,"reason":"稳定砺纹可收束乱息，增加主人灵抗，提供术法与诅咒防线；不是五行全抗。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.cloud-step","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"石芯不驱动步法，不借鞋履能力给砺石增加移速词。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.resonant","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"共鸣已经退池；砺纹长度也不是攻击命中范围。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.enduring","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"绵长已退池，本件没有可延长的状态时间来源。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.clear-water","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"用水磨刃不产生足部避水能力，砺石不随机碧水。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"锋金给本器附加金伤，砺石没有攻击包，不能成为全场附伤来源。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.metal-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有本器金伤基底，不能随机金盛。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有本器木伤，青芒也不会从磨石滋生根缚。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.wood-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有本器木伤，木盛不能提高磨石或治疗。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"洒水磨锋不是水伤接触，砺石不能随机寒露。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.water-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有自己的水伤基础，不借附近水剑作为本器水伤基底。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fire-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"磨刃火星是表现，砺石没有火伤攻击包，不能给主人全局附火。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.fire-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有本器火伤，火盛不提高磨石亮度或主人威力。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.earth-flat","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"石头不等于土伤武器，砂砾不能凭材质给全场附土。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.earth-increased","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有自己的土伤基础，不按石材联想授予土盛。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spellpower","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"明法增强本器术法伤害，砺石只增加主人物理威力，不借磨砺概念强化法术。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.qi-capacity","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"藏灵只扩单剑器气，砺石没有剑体灵池。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.physical-speed","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"当前没有可掉落的持握近战底材，不把未接入的迅手消费者算作已完成前缀。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.spell-speed","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"砺石没有行囊施法光环，法术动作点数也不改变物理威力。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.artifact-speed","allowed":false,"weight":0,"reason":"御疾只改变对应飞剑的御器动作，不能直接搬到砺石给全体免动作。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.hit-recovery","allowed":true,"weight":0.5,"reason":"持砺定神的刻纹缩短主人受击恢复帧；不减伤、不减击退，与卸势各有作用。"},{"effectId":"effect.affix.edge-honing","allowed":true,"weight":1.4,"reason":"重新开出锋口增加主人物理威力点数，再受砺石既有比例影响；必须有可获得的物理正系数攻击。","requiresReceiver":"owner-physical-power-attack"}]},"modifiers":[{"stat":"physicalPower","operation":"increased","value":0.04,"source":"trinket:whetstone"}]}}
